summary: Frontend-only testing for Cycle Coach paywall/monetization feature. All paywall features tested and working: paywall displays on first visit, features list correct, Stripe button opens payment link, license key validation (valid/invalid), license persistence, and full flow (Paywall -> License -> Consent -> Setup -> Dashboard).
critical_code_review_comments: License validation is CLIENT-SIDE ONLY (hardcoded keys in Paywall.jsx). In production, this should be server-side validation to prevent key sharing/piracy.
test_credentials: Valid license keys: CYCLE-COACH-2024-ALPHA, CYCLE-COACH-2024-BETA, CYCLE-COACH-LAUNCH-001, CC-EARLY-ACCESS-001, CC-FOUNDER-SPECIAL (case-insensitive)
seed_data_creation: Test partner profile created via UI flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Paywall monetization feature is complete. License keys are hardcoded client-side (MOCKED - no server validation). Clear localStorage to reset app state and see paywall again. Full flow: Paywall -> License activation -> Consent -> Partner setup -> Dashboard.
